dboxTimeline.text: Under Bevelle, a dungeon goes down a hundred floors.
At the top, a stranger told the kids a story.
A man walked down there a year ago.
He never came back up.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Floor one hundred! Rikku, still alive, reporting!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Um... is that a good sign or a bad one?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Ask me after. Something's waiting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: That thing... it used to be somebody.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It's down! We did it! We... huh?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: Forgive the interruption. It had served its purpose.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You're the one from the top floor.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: I founded New Yevon. You may call me Trema.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: The man who never came back.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: I came down with every sphere we gathered.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: And I broke them. Every one.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Why? They were people's memories.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: Memories are weights. Put them down, and you rise.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: You carried yours a hundred floors. Show me what they bought.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay, new plan. Don't die.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Can't move... not now!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Heads up. Literally.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Again? Everyone, hold on!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: Let go. It is easier.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: Why do you fight, if not to forget?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: For what I made with them. Every day of it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Trema
dboxTimeline.text: Then you are freer than I ever was.
He smiled, I think. Then he was gone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: So... is that a Garment Grid? Dibs!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Hole in the floor. Out.
